name: Business Engineering Corporation
summary: Business Engineering Corporation designs, develops, and implements corporate information systems using ERP package products developed by other companies in Japan. It operates through Solution Business; Product Business; and System Support Business segments. The company provides IT planning consulting, system implementation consulting, system utilization consulting, project management service, system construction, template provision, offshore development, and overseas implementation support services. It also develops, sells, and introduces its packaged IT products, such as the mcframe series, GLASIAOUS, and Business b-ridge, as well as provides product development, product sales and marketing…
